title: RealTime MR-Imaging in pediatric medicine
summary: It is to be examined if the RealTime MRI technology can be used with a 1.5 Tesla MRI to inproove the diagnostic value esp. in uncooperative children to reduce unsuccessful examinations and the need for general anesthesia. Furthermore the substitution of X-ray based fluoroscopic imaging is to be evaluated.
conditions: everything, i.E. hydrocephalus, intracranial bleeding, tumor disease in whole body, liver- and intestinal disease

interventions.name:
RealTime MR sequences will be acquired in addition to conventional sequences. Patients enrolled in the study are children at any age with indication for MR Imaging if consent is given by their parents and contraindications for MRI are ruled out.
The patients are included due to clinical indication

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
none
Exclusion criteria:
MRI contraindications
